title: Delete unwired input batching/coalescing pipeline; invariant 2 tests on input_event_bus
description:
Goal: Delete the input pipeline production never uses and point invariant 2 at the real transactional/ephemeral lane.

Non-goals: Changing production input delivery behavior.

Governing spec: docs/scope.md T8 row (delete code without a current user; behavior tests tied to docs/invariants.md; resource tests; llvmpipe recipe; strip pre-reset refs) and 'Working rules' (prefer deleting over generalizing; tests guard behavior a user would notice, not internal structure); docs/vision.md; docs/invariants.md; CLAUDE.md Rules; AGENTS.md (just recipes).

T7 boundary: do not edit crates/tze_hud_projection/**, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs, crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/windowed/portal.rs, crates/tze_hud_input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs, crates/tze_hud_config/src/portal_tokens.rs, crates/tze_hud_mcp/src/portal_op.rs or tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs; keep every pub item those files import until T7 (epic hud-lirh2) lands.

Line refs are at windows-release-pipeline@44d355ef (same content as main@1eb8f7cb); re-grep symbols before editing. The planning survey is not persisted; this bead is self-contained.
design:
Files:
- crates/tze_hud_input/src/batching.rs (342), coalescing.rs (513), event_queue.rs (217), envelope.rs (448), lib.rs:26-72
- crates/tze_hud_protocol/src/session_server/input_event_bus.rs (178 lines, 0 tests), fed by runtime windowed/input_dispatch.rs:503-600
- scroll.rs (latest-wins scroll)
- docs/invariants.md §2
- tests/integration/text_stream_portal_surface.rs:1120-1160 uses FrameCoalescer (T7 file; land after T7)

Evidence:
Invariant 2 tests test_pointer_move_coalesced_in_batch (batching.rs:284) and test_coalesce_scroll_latest_wins (coalescing.rs:349) exercise EventBatchAssembler/EventCoalescer/FrameCoalescer/AgentEventQueue/envelope, none used in production. In production pointer moves are dropped on lag.

Approach:
Delete the four modules; add `ephemeral_pointer_moves_drop_on_lag_and_report_lagged` and `transactional_pointer_down_up_survive_slow_consumer` to input_event_bus; move scroll latest-wins to scroll.rs; rewrite invariants.md §2 to say pointer moves are droppable on lag and list the new tests.

Tests:
Delete the two old inv 2 input tests (replaced); add 2-3.

Expected delta: about -1,550 / +120

Every test named in docs/invariants.md is kept, or moved/renamed with docs/invariants.md updated in the same PR. Local builds on this host need `PROTOC=$HOME/.local/protoc/bin/protoc` (/usr/bin/protoc 3.12 fails on types.proto).

[decision] Invariant 2: pointer moves are droppable on lag (that IS invariant 2's ephemeral class); move/replace its input tests onto input_event_bus.rs.
acceptance_criteria:

4. `cargo test -p integration --tests` passes.
5. docs/invariants.md §2 names the new input_event_bus tests and they pass.
6. Deletion check: `git grep -nE 'EventBatchAssembler|EventCoalescer|FrameCoalescer|AgentEventQueue|test_pointer_move_coalesced_in_batch' -- crates tests docs` prints nothing (no remaining references).
7. Every test named in docs/invariants.md still exists (grep each name) or docs/invariants.md was updated in the same PR.
8. `just ci` is green once before handoff.
